analyzed_vuln.description: completeMolQueries() incorrectly assumes every atom query is an ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY and force-casts atom->getQuery() (and children in completeQueryAndChildren) with static_cast. For molecules where parsing builds a composite query tree (e.g., AtomAnd from expandQuery in property-line parsing), this downcast is invalid and triggers UB when completeMolQueries traverses it.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In MolDataStreamToMol(), an M  RBC line with count -2 causes ParseRingBondCountLine() to set a sentinel value (0xDEADBEEF) and mark _NeedsQueryScan, while also attaching the ring-bond query via expandQuery (creating an AtomAnd/composite query on the atom). During finishMolProcessing(), presence of _NeedsQueryScan unconditionally calls QueryOps::completeMolQueries(), which then static_casts the top-level query to ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY despite it being AtomAnd, causing the UBSan invalid downcast. The provided PoC uses a single-atom mol block with 'M  RBC  1   1  -2' to trigger this path.
